name: test-prep-signup
description: Registration & login workflow for a high-school test-prep questionnaire app (free mode only)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev client/dist --compatibility-flags=nodejs_compat
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy client/dist
